unresolved.first_comment: P2: Apps with more than 128 generated state classes will repeatedly miss this LRU during metadata lookups. The class-local dictionary already memoizes each value, so remove the bounded LRU and use the per-class cache directly.

failing_job_findings.check: integration-app-harness (memory + redis, Python 3.11-3.14, both shards -- 16/16 jobs)
failing_job_findings.cause: Real, reproducible regression on the current head (306c2386), not flaky: every memory- and redis-backed integration-app-harness job fails the same way. Core failure is in tests/integration/test_connection_banner.py::test_connection_banner[compile_context_run/deploy] -- 'AssertionError: assert '<token>' in mappingproxy({})' where mappingproxy({}) is <LocalTokenManager|RedisTokenManager>.token_to_sid, i.e. after a client connects, its token is never registered in the token-to-sid map. This cascades into selenium NoSuchElementException failures across test_component_state.py, test_linked_state.py (test_linked_state, test_unrelated_reset_does_not_break_shared_event_link_context, test_concurrent_async_vars_do_not_deadlock_linked_token), test_navigation.py::test_navigation_app, and test_lifespan.py (test_lifespan_modify_state, test_lifespan_raw_asyncio_task) -- all consistent with the page never fully connecting/hydrating. This directly implicates the PR's own new connect-packet boot-event flow (on_connect / link_token_to_sid / hydrate_and_load auth path) added in this PR; it appeared on the final commit (306c2386) pushed after all prior review threads were fixed and marked resolved, so it was never itself reviewed.
